extraction_notes: The datasheet is a family table; the SMBJ5338B row was used.
The datasheet note states that the nominal zener voltage has a standard tolerance of plus or minus 5 percent.
The SMBJ5338B row gives maximum zener impedance ZZT = 1.5 ohm at IZT = 240 mA and ZZK = 400 ohm at IZK = 1.0 mA; the strict diode schema has no impedance fields.
The SMBJ5338B row gives maximum DC zener current IZM = 0.93 A and maximum surge current IZSM = 14.4 A; the strict diode schema has no dedicated fields for these ratings.
No capacitance or reverse-recovery specification is published.

The characteristics page contains thermal, power, temperature-coefficient, and thermal-response plots, but no diode forward-I-V, zener-V-I, capacitance, or reverse-recovery curve usable for this schema.
extraction.omission_reason: No usable diode electrical curve is provided. The only plotted characteristics are thermal, power, temperature-coefficient, and thermal-response curves, so no forward-I-V, zener-V-I, capacitance, or reverse-recovery points were digitized.
